transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... just having some trouble at my apartment. The people there... they're watching me. Keeping track of my comings and goings. I know they're slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices they put on the doors, but... I know what it is. So, I guess that's why I'm here.
How long have you felt that the people at your apartment are watching you?
...It's been a while. I guess... maybe a year and a month. Give or take. Just... around then is when I noticed it.
Have you ever heard voices, whispering, or other sounds that other people around you couldn't hear?
...No. I don't hear voices or anything like that. Just... no.
Over the past year, have you been struggling with feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
...Yeah. I guess so. Most mornings I just... wake up with this heavy feeling. Like it's all hollow. Just... feels like the day's already gone bad before I even get my feet on the floor. So... yeah.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, down feeling?

...I don't know exactly. It's been a long time. I guess... maybe a year and a couple of months. Just... that heavy feeling where there's no point to anything. Started pulling away from things around then, too. So... yeah, about that long.
Over this past year, have there been any times when your down mood lifted and you felt back to normal?

...No. Not really. I mean... maybe some days I sound a little better, or my head feels a bit clearer. But... underneath it, I still feel low. Just... useless, I guess. Haven't cared about the things I used to do for most of the time since I moved. So... no, never really back to normal.
Has there ever been a time when you felt people were watching you, but you were not feeling depressed or down?

...Yeah, I suppose there was. A while back, there was maybe... a few weeks. I was eating a little better, I guess. Didn't wake up feeling quite as... hollow. But... I still knew they were watching. The neighbors. Keeping an eye on my door, keeping track of me. Even when the heavy feeling wasn't so bad, I still knew they were doing that. So... yeah.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?
...No. Never really felt like that. Just... usually tired. Don't really get wired or anything.
